---
name: Feature request
about: Propose a focused improvement or extension point
labels: enhancement
---

## Problem

What concrete user or maintainer problem should this solve?

## Proposed behavior

Describe the smallest useful behavior or interface. Examples and failure cases are helpful.

## Why this belongs in the core project

Explain why this should live in Learning Agent rather than in an external adapter, provider implementation, or application-specific layer.

## Compatibility / migration

Does this change persisted state, APIs, tool contracts, model-provider behavior, configuration, or existing workflows?

## Validation plan

What tests or end-to-end checks would demonstrate that the change works without regressing the current Hy3 path?
